/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261015T091107662579-scg-dd-reclassify-finish/manifest.md:13 follow-on: negative_control_log is not the bare path the field requires -- it carries two paths and prose on one line -- and the path it names, passes/readback-201.log, contains only the final green run (command, one wrote line, EXIT=0) with none of the 0/201 red state the note describes, so the declared control is unreadable as a control.

docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-dd-reclassify-finish-run.py:148 follow-on: _score divides matches by len(graph) rather than the label count, so a labelled path absent from the graph leaves the denominator silently and inflates the reported accuracy; the two counts coincide at 201 here, which is why the defect is invisible in this run's numbers.
